title: Layout App System Integration
description: Wire Layout into workbench/catalogue/details/hover conventions: draggable Catalogue tab, selectable frame kinds in Document, editable Inspection panel, bidirectional hover between canvas and panels.
summary: Integrated Layout into the app/workbench system: added document commands (add_page, add_frame, patch_page_props, patch_frame_props) with factories and undo support; added Catalogue workbench tab with draggable Page/Rect/Text/Image kinds; extended Document with selectable frame rows and catalogue drop handling; rewrote Inspection panel with editable fields for pages and frames; wired bidirectional hover between canvas, document, and catalogue via AppPointerFocusStore; added Rust/TS hover rendering with distinct hover stroke on blueprint canvas.
